hook: A dad in orange glasses cradles a sleeping foster puppy on the couch and talks quietly to camera
title: Foster Puppy Day 23
caption:
Quiet couch moment: a dad, a sleeping foster puppy and a very tired face. Anyone who has ever stayed still for hours so a little one could sleep will get it. Could you tell how long he had been sitting there?

Save this for your next nap-trap night and follow for more real parent moments.
